target_module: origins/client/actor-clips.ts (proposed path; not located); strike timing in src/fight/ (duel step)
best_idea: An action owns its clip and its length; it ends when the clip runs out, with a frame-keyed event at a chosen frame, so the strike's contact frame and the attack's end come from the same data.
decision_why: The duration-from-clip and contact-frame event fit a hero or creature strike where the server resolves damage on the contact frame (row 7, with row 6 for the hero), but the server must own the frame counter and the donor's sprite model is not a rig.
acceptance: A server test asserts the strike's damage entry is written on the strike start tick plus the contact-frame index, and the strike ends at the clip length with no separate timer; on the client a creature returns to its stance clip exactly when the clip's last frame plays.
